dct_description_sm: Our long-term goal is to evaluate the subtle behavioural effects of the low-to-moderate perinatal exposure to environmental contaminants, and to dissociate the effects of each group of contaminants by using accurate innovative methods of behavioural assessments.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Persistent organic pollutants (POPs)
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Schools
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Inuit population
dct_title_s: Behavioural effects of perinatal exposure to environmental contaminants in Inuit children
